plan_review.notes: Retrospective review identified and addressed workflow staging for canonical lore files, non-circular source citations, complete brief-family scanning, and per-section Sources declarations. The Ollama wording was not treated as a contradiction because the older game-design document describes a proposal while the constitution constrains any implemented runtime generation; no source was silently selected or canonized.

code_review.notes: Round 1 added retry-path token coverage. Round 2 identified the workflow success guard for lore validation; the guard and regression assertion were added before final validation.

findings.detail: If a required section is missing, the source-declaration check can redundantly report it; guard the section lookup before slicing.
Future Lore Bible sections require addition to REQUIRED_SECTIONS before provenance is enforced; consider dynamic heading coverage.

independent_grade.notes: The canonical lore workflow is correctly integrated, deterministic, provenance-backed, scoped to documentation and tooling, and covered by focused tests. Minor maintainability improvements are possible but do not block the change.
